NATS JetStream backend for Anarchon, on NATS.Net: JetStream message de-duplication decides which instance runs each time, and the Lease strategy adds backup runners, retries, catch-up and no overlapping runs through a key-value bucket.

SQLite backend for Anarchon, on Microsoft.Data.Sqlite: one BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction claims each run, with backup runners, retries, catch-up and no overlapping runs, for the processes of one machine that open the same file.

Redis and Valkey backend for Anarchon, on StackExchange.Redis: one atomic Lua script or XADD claims each run; the default Lease strategy adds backup runners, retries, catch-up and no overlapping runs.

Leaderless cron and interval scheduling for .NET services, coordinated through your existing datastore. An atomic claim selects one runner per attempt; with a lease backend another instance retries a run whose runner failed.
PostgreSQL backend for Anarchon, on Npgsql: one short transaction claims each run, with backup runners, retries, catch-up and no overlapping runs. Leases run on the database's clock.

The SQL lease store shared by Anarchon's SQL backends (Anarchon.Postgres, Anarchon.Sqlite), on ADO.NET: one short transaction claims each run, leases run on the database's clock. Reference it directly only to put Anarchon on another database.
RabbitMQ backend for Anarchon, on RabbitMQ.Client: a gate queue per run that holds one message, with publisher confirms, decides which instance runs each time. Claim only: no leases.
